notes.title: Untraveled Lands: Chantico - PLAYTEST IS LIVE – Help Us Break It!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, adventurers!

It's been a while since you've heard from us the last time. But we are still here and working on the game.[/p][p]We’re about to kick off a limited playtest to polish the game before launch. Now we’re looking for a few dedicated players to dive in, explore, and help us find what still needs fixing.[/p][p][/p][p]🧪 What’s this about?[/p][p]This isn’t a beta or a marketing thing, it’s a focused playtest. We want real feedback on gameplay flow, balance, system quirks, edge cases, and any bugs you can dig up.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Info:[/p][p]• When: June 16–29, 2025[/p][p]• Where: Steam (PC)[/p][p]• Slots: 20–30 players[/p][p]• Access: Closed, invite-only[/p][p][/p][p]🙋 Anyone can join but here’s who we’re especially looking for:[/p][p]• You enjoy card games and survival systems[/p][p]• You have time to play and provide honest, helpful feedback[/p][p]• You’re not afraid to experiment, break stuff, or go deep on mechanics[/p][p][/p][p]⚡️ How to join:[/p][p]DM kuriharayui on Discord to sign up - spots are limited on a first come first served basis.[/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/pAwf8xQsN7"]Discord[/url] to stay updated on news and game progress.[/p][p][/p][p]Really appreciate your help! Your input will directly shape the final stretch of development. [/p][p]Let’s make Chantico truly shine![/p]

notes.title: Whip-Cracking News: Chantico Strikes Gold in Untraveled Lands! 🐍💰🎮
notes.notes:
🌟 Adventurers, gather ’round! We’ve unearthed some exhilarating news straight from the treasure trove! 🎉✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/877730adf70db8afb582ba7ef40eb48057351980.png[/img]

Untraveled Lands: Chantico has claimed the coveted Industry Gold Award at the Tencent Game Creation Competition (GWB2024) in Wuhan, China! 🏆🏜️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/565af8c238dde15aa45ee359915f0f7f08b9c95c.png[/img]

The biggest indie game festival in China showcased an awe-inspiring 7,400 entries from 72 countries and regions, highlighting talent from all corners of the globe. In the International Category, only 61 games rose to prominence out of 570+ submissions—talk about a challenge worthy of a true adventurer!

Here’s how the spoils were divvied up:
🏆 Industry Gold Award: Untraveled Lands: Chantico
🥈 Silver Awards: Freaked Fleapit and Balatro


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/6eea1fa12fee4687b95c880645dbfcc15900da51.png[/img]
Let us also give a huge congratulations to Balatro for claiming second place at GWB2024! 🥈 🎉 
“Together, we made card games totally prevail this year! 🃏👏”

notes.title: Estonian Game of the Year 2024
notes.notes:
Dear Explorers!

We have an update from the Estonian Game of the Year 2024 awards! 🎮
While we didn’t take home the top prize, we’re excited to announce that Untraveled Lands: Chantico claimed second place, missing the gold by just 1 point! 🥈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/3ba5c958ff321cf149e0b7100919ac80f6e22197.png[/img]

Honestly, we’re calling it a "silver medal with a touch of gold polish!" (And we’re almost not crying 😅) 
It’s an achievement we’re incredibly proud of, and one we’ll gladly add to the game’s accolades. Besides, silver shines pretty brightly too, right? 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/4564e390e0cb9aa56b833a2acd7b85e50f0ac929.png[/img]

We were also overjoyed to see so many of you trying our game and leaving such positive feedback - it truly means the world to us. Thank you all for your continued support! 🙌

We’d also like to send a huge congratulations to the team behind Bootstrap Island, who took first place, and to all the other amazing developers and their fantastic games. We’re excited to see MOAR GAMES from Estonia next year!

This is just the beginning, and we’ll keep pushing forward with exciting updates and improvements.

notes.title: Save Chantico! Demo 2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow explorers!

We are happy to present you with the Untraveled Lands: Chantico Demo 2.0. Update the game to the latest version to experience all the new changes.

The demo is now available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German, Japanese, French, Polish, and Korean.

Since the release, we have showcased the demo at events, received a few award nominations, and gathered feedback from players. The highly requested save feature has finally been added to the demo:
[list]
[*]From now on, you can play the game and save your progress without worrying about starting over.
[*]Crafting items with blueprints from the journal is now optional, not mandatory. If you know the recipe, just stack the cards together and craft whatever you like.
[*]Blueprints have been updated too. Now you get a notification when the blueprint is ready, and you only need to add a survivor to craft the final result.
[*]You can grow plants by simply combining soil and plants. No survivor is required in this process anymore.
[*]Some of you requested more speed options for the game. Now we have normal, x2, and x3 speed settings. A small hint: you can switch game speed by pressing 1, 2, 3, and spacebar for pausing the game on your keyboard.
[*]We are adding more music and sounds by our composer and audio designer.
[*]Some minor changes to improve the game flow.
[/list]

As usual, we have resolved some bugs and issues to make the game play more smoothly. We are in a constant search for more, so if you find any, don't hesitate to share them with us.

Our friends in Shanghai can find Untraveled Lands: Chantico at BiliBili World from July 12, 2024, until July 14, 2024. Our booth number is 2G2-9, 2G2-10. We are excited to meet you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/430bd7312c2f622878787cad862df43685a6def2.jpg[/img]

We're committed to collecting your suggestions and feedback to keep improving the demo and provide a better gaming experience! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pAwf8xQsN7]discord channel[/url] or follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ULChantico]Twitter (X) account[/url] to stay updated on the game's progress or to chat and connect with other players!

notes.title: Demo Update & Simplified Chinese Now Supported!
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers!

Untraveled Lands: Chantico has updated the Demo to include a Simplified Chinese version! Update game to the latest version to experience it in Chinese. 

Besides Simplified Chinese, we are also working on localizations for Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), German, Japanese, French, Polish, and Korean. Stay tuned!

Since the Demo release, we've received lots of feedback and have made several updates and fixes:
[list]
[*]Resolved various bugs that were blocking the game, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
[*]Added the Altar recipe to the journal to prevent it from being lost when removed from the playing field.
[*]Improved the management and consumption of food for a more balanced gameplay experience.
[*]Monkeys no longer consume food at the end of the day. Players now need to feed them bananas only to tame them.
[*]Adjusted exploration times for better pacing and challenge.
[*]Added a dedicated confirmation for videohints to prevent them from being closed accidentally or due to errors.
[/list]

We're committed to collecting your suggestions and feedback to keep improving the Demo and provide a better gaming experience! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pAwf8xQsN7]discord channel[/url] or follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ULChantico]Twitter (X) account[/url] to stay updated on the game's progress or to chat and connect with other players!

notes.title: Indiana Jones inspired card game blends survival crafting and tabletop
notes.notes:
A mixture of survival crafting and roguelike deckbuilder, Untraveled Lands Chantico is a new card game inspired by the likes of Indiana Jones and Mesoamerican culture, from developer Tall Troll Games. The team behind clever turn-based strategy game Dark Chess has turned its hand to a management game that perhaps more closely resembles tabletop card games, and it's coming to Steam later this year.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Untraveled Lands: Chantico Store Page Revealed!
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

The store page for the card-based survival management game [b]Untraveled Lands: Chantico[/b] is now officially live. Please follow the link below to check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496590/_Untraveled_Lands/

[b]Untraveled Lands: Chantico[/b] is the latest game developed by our studio. It's a card-based survival management game with elements of roguelite gameplay. 

In this game, you'll step into the shoes of a survivor lost in the dense rainforest, establish camps, manage other survivors, and craft essential items and equipment to endure the dangers of the mysterious jungle. At the same time, the rainforest, infused with the mysterious Mesoamerican culture, awaits your exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930864/89683cc37a4a608df5ef70edcc88ad3e96cc0e80.png[/img]

We're planning to release Chantico in the fourth quarter of 2024. The game with support for English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish-Spain, Portuguese-Brazil, German, Japanese, French, Polish, and Korean languages. 

Currently, we're still in the middle stages of development. You can add Chantico to your wishlist, join our [url=https://discord.gg/pAwf8xQsN7]Discord[/url] channel, or follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ULChantico]Twitter[/url] account to stay updated on the latest developments and exciting snippets from the game.
